title: Identifying Gaussian Causal Forests When Error Variances Take Few Unknown Levels
banked_reason: The proposed unrestricted latent-K classification remains open; the delivered bounded-component and supplied-order algorithms are a strictly weaker substituted kernel.
gap_reasons: The proposed unrestricted latent-K classification (FPT or faithful linear-budget hardness) remains an open question; the delivered bounded-d and supplied-order algorithms are a strictly weaker kernel and must be positioned as such rather than as resolution of that frontier.
no theorem determines whether unrestricted K-Fiber is FPT or parameterized-hard.
proof_attempt_summary: The run repaired and proved the rational tree-covariance realization criterion, root-locus structure, a bounded-component d^K algorithm, a refined supplied-order dynamic program, and a two-valued total-effect fiber theorem. The attempted selector/compatibility reductions failed because common-center gadgets admit a cheap universal witness while varying centers create complementary labels, and no twin-star-resistant FPT invariant emerged. Unrestricted feasibility and uniqueness in K, plus the matching recurrence-width lower bound, therefore remain open and cannot be replaced by the restricted results.
tldr: Arbitrary Gaussian error variances identify only a Markov-equivalence class, one common variance identifies the DAG, and a supplied partial-homoscedastic partition refines the class. This project studies the missing observational regime in which the equality partition is not supplied: a faithful rational Gaussian forest covariance is compatible with a root tuple when its exact regression residuals use at most \(K\) numerical values. The supplied-order dynamic program now has the refined binomial state bound \(\sum_{i=0}^{\min(q_\pi,K)}\binom{q_\pi}{i}(K-i+1)\), preserving exact decision, uniqueness, and two-witness recovery and giving both the earlier base-two bound and a \(q_\pi^{O(K)}\) regime. The bounded-component algorithm costs \(d^K\operatorname{poly}(N,K)\). For designated vertices, the population total-effect fiber is empty with the structural fiber; conditional on nonemptiness it is \(\{1\}\) on the diagonal, is \(\{0\}\) across components, and within a component is a subset of \(\{0,\Sigma_{yx}/\Sigma_{xx}\}\). Each within-component value is present exactly when the corresponding side of the first path edge admits a feasible root, and both algorithms recover witnesses. The unrestricted \(K\)-frontier, uniqueness classification, and matching recurrence-width lower bound remain open. A covariance-region projection propagates sampling uncertainty to orientations and effects but is not claimed to be computationally efficient over the covariance region.
gap: Published equal-variance and partial-homoscedastic theory either fixes one common level or supplies the equality partition. Generic minimum-label hardness does not survive the algebraic and arithmetic restrictions of Gaussian residual signatures.
fill: The project gives a root-union reduction, an exact rational tree-signature realization theorem with the piecewise diagonal and path-product covariance reconstructed by an arbitrary-root SEM, symbolic root loci, positive algorithms at bounded component size and bounded recurrence width, and an answer-open classification theorem whose negative branch must certify edge residuals, positive definiteness, faithfulness, rationality, and bit length before using any Gaussian gadget.
